title: MQTT QR after fresh board setup
summary: The Share panel can now show the MQTT QR as soon as a USB-connected board has usable online settings saved, instead of waiting for the board to reboot and report a live MQTT session.

title: Guide images and clearer modules
summary: The guide now uses the latest workspace screenshots with focused image previews on walkthrough pages, and the script modules are split into clearer topics such as Math and motion, Local time, and Sun location.

title: Faster USB reconnect recovery
summary: USB reconnect now waits for the browser serial port to close cleanly and recovers faster when the board is already speaking MessagePack, while still falling back to JSON if needed.

title: UI tab and cache refresh
summary: The UI tab now stays available while it is the active view, and the web cache tag was bumped so browsers pick up the latest workspace files together.

title: Own LLM guide
summary: The guide now has a page for using ChatGPT or another LLM with the public XOBIT Wrench context URL, plus copy buttons for guide prompt and code boxes.

title: Smarter UI tab
summary: The workspace UI tab is quieter until a running sketch exposes live controls, so projects without a browser UI do not show an empty UI view as prominently.

title: Web UI theme and sharing polish
summary: The browser workspace got a cleaner light/dark theme setup, tighter toolbar spacing, calmer borders, and a new Share panel with QR links, focused UI-only links, plus a safer bug report download for the current revision.

title: AI tab soft-hide and topbar polish
summary: The AI tab now stays visible for early discovery, then hides after repeated successful uploads when no API key is stored. The topbar logo, version lines, and settings/info controls were also tightened to reduce visual jitter.

title: Signal group QR added to the guide frontpage
summary: The guide frontpage now shows a small scannable QR link for the XOBIT Signal group, aligned with the right-side alpha note.

title: Signal group and bug reporting notes added
summary: The guide frontpage now links to the XOBIT Signal group, and the About and Change Log pages now explain where to discuss ideas and where to send heavier bug reports.

title: Searchable change log with topic icons
summary: The Change Log now loads from a JSON file, shows topic icons for each entry, and can be searched or filtered by topic.

title: Examples project, module guide, and cleaner Generate
summary: The project selector now includes a special Examples project with starter sketches across modules. The guide now speaks in Modules instead of API families, and Generate now creates a new revision with a cleaned definition, a better sketch name, and no AI-made circuit layout.

title: Change log added to the guide
summary: The guide now has a Change Log page for short notes about visible web changes and firmware deploys.
